articles.title: Small-ball Rays beat sloppy Yankees for 2-0 ALDS lead
articles.description: Richie Palacios hit a two-run single in a four-run fifth inning, and host Tampa Bay took advantage of four New York errors to beat Cam Schlittler and the Yankees.

articles.title: White Sox surge past Guardians to take 2-0 lead in ALDS, move one win away from ALCS
articles.description: Braden Montgomery's two-run double put Chicago in front, and Sean Burke tossed 5⅓ innings of one-hit relief to beat Cleveland.

articles.title: Red Sox believe Roman Anthony won’t need surgery to fix right hand injury
articles.description: Roman Anthony dealt with a recurrence of an injury to his right ring finger as well as other hand issues in the first of the Red Sox’ two postseason games.

articles.title: No matter what they say, the Red Sox are a second-tier team until they prove otherwise
articles.description: The Sox also have gone eight years without winning the division and five years without winning 90 games.

articles.title: Craig Breslow and Chad Tracy meet with Willson Contreras, defend Red Sox’ in-game moves: ‘It’s my decision. It went south.’
articles.description: Tracy said he has spoken with Sonny Gray, who was unhappy about being pulled in the fifth inning of what turned out to be the Red Sox’ last game of the season.

articles.title: Craig Breslow, Chad Tracy, Sam Kennedy hold Red Sox end-of-season press conference | Replay
articles.description: The team's management triumvirate addressed Boston's postseason exit, the impending labor battle, and more with reporters.

articles.title: Ben Rice and Cam Schlittler show why scouts matter, and other Red Sox thoughts
articles.description: Veteran Yankees scout Matt Hyde followed Rice and Schlittler throughout high school and championed them when they became draft-eligible in college.

articles.title: Michael Harris II leads Braves to win over Dodgers in Game 2 to tie NLDS
articles.description: Harris was a home run shy of the cycle, and drove in the game-winning run on an RBI double in the seventh inning.

articles.title: Jackson Chourio’s two-run walk-off single off of Mason Miller lifts Brewers to NLDS Game 2 victory
articles.description: Chourio's single came with his team down to its final out off of Miller, who tied for the National League lead with 38 saves this season.

articles.title: Brewers edge Padres in NLDS opener that features a ball off the roof in the ninth inning
articles.description: Ty France hit the roof of American Family Field and the ball landed in the glove of Brewers left fielder Jackson Choirio for the second out of the ninth inning.

articles.title: Tarik Skubal dominates in 100-degree heat as the Dodgers beat the Braves in NLDS opener
articles.description: The two-time Cy Young Award winner allowed one run and two hits, struck out seven and walked two while starting a postseason game at home for the first time in his career.

articles.title: The Red Sox went their separate ways. With a lockout looming, nobody knows when they will reunite.
articles.description: A possible lockout in 2027 adds to the uncertainty.

articles.title: White Sox beat Guardians in Game 1 of ALDS behind Munetaka Murakami homer
articles.description: It was the sixth White Sox postseason shutout, their first since the finale of a 2005 World Series sweep of Houston.

articles.title: Why not give rooting for the White Sox, a team loaded with Red Sox and other local connections, a try?
articles.description: In addition to 2018 world champion Andrew Benintendi, the White Sox boast ex-Red Sox prospects Chase Meidroth, Braden Montgomery, and Kyle Teel. And there are other local tie-ins.

articles.title: Despite another early exit, Sam Kennedy says Red Sox believe in promise of Craig Breslow
articles.description: In speaking with the Globe before the playoffs began, the Sox CEO discussed long-term continuity at the top baseball job.

articles.title: In the end the Red Sox were who we thought they were, and other thoughts
articles.description: The Red Sox have won exactly one playoff series in the last eight seasons.
